count_basis: national_count and local_count sum ledger record_count for national and municipal rows. record_count is sizes.num_rows from the pinned inventory when the collection is eligible and that integer is present. A dataset with more than one level repeats the same viewer total on each of its rows. Classifier-blocked rows keep record_count null. No row is an ingest receipt: WWL-018 admitted no source child and no verify manifest is present. These counts are not legal completeness.
